title: thresholded-audit-bench-for-batch-cache-autonomy
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an independent audit benchmark and automated gating system that validates batching/caching recommendations before they are applied to production. The system emits a single pass/fail verdict against configurable thresholds and supports automated rollback triggers and manual human-in-the-loop approval flows.
background: Previous attempts to auto-apply batching and cache recommendations reduced token cost but occasionally caused subtle quality regressions for specific prompt patterns. Existing artifacts (golden prompts, probe suites) are fragmented across teams and lack a single thresholded signal we can use to gate automated applies or trigger safe rollback.
goals: Design an audit bench that runs candidate config changes through a set of deterministic checks and statistical tests
Define clear numeric thresholds for quality regressions tied to cost-savings decisions
Integrate bench with the Autoscaler/Planner so apply operations can be blocked or flagged based on results
Provide a human-review path and fast rollback mechanism when automated checks fail
scope: Implement end-to-end bench: ingestion of candidate config, execution against synthetic and production-sampled prompt sets, metric computation (fidelity, n-gram overlap, semantic score), threshold evaluation, decision output (allow/deny/require-review), and integration points for rollout orchestration. Deliver dashboards and an audit log for each decision.
out_of_scope: Wide-scale retraining or model changes, long-term storage of all evaluation artifacts beyond retention policy, new model onboarding flow modifications (handled in separate project).
deliverables: automated quality scorer (semantic similarity + behavioral checks)
decision API (allow/deny/review) and webhook for rollout controller
rollback-orchestrator playbook and a one-click rollback endpoint
dashboard with per-change signal breakdown and historical trends
success_metrics: No more than 0.5% of autopplied configs produce >5% degradation on golden prompts (measured over next 3 months)
Automated bench blocks at least 95% of risky applies before they reach canary
Mean time to rollback (automated) under 2 minutes from detection
False positive rate on allowed/reject decisions under 8% compared to human review
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Shadow mode for all autosuggests (no blocking) for 2 weeks; collect signal and tune thresholds
Phase 2: Block autopplies that fail hard thresholds, require manual review for borderline results (10–20% canary only), run for 1 week
Phase 3: Enable automated rollback triggers for hard failures in canary and ramp to full apply with monitoring
Contingency: automatic rollback + page SRE and notify owning PM/Eng if rollback fires twice in 24h
test_plan: Unit tests for metric calculators and threshold logic
Synthetic suites: adversarial prompts targeting prefix reuse and KV cache edge cases
Production-sampled test: run candidate on 10k recent real requests in shadow with preserved metadata
Human audit: 200 samples from any failed run reviewed by a cross-functional panel
Stress test: bench performance when evaluating 50 concurrent candidate configs
acceptance_criteria: Bench produces deterministic verdicts for repeated inputs and records full repro artifacts
All decision outputs have an associated confidence score and reason code
Decision API integrated with autoscaler/plan service and can block an apply call
Rollback endpoint successfully reverts a config applied in canary within 2 minutes in 5/5 test replays
Dashboard renders per-change breakdown and historical false-positive statistics
risks_mitigation: Risk: Bench false negatives allow regressions. Mitigation: combine multiple orthogonal metrics (semantic similarity, token-level diffs, behavior fingerprinting) and conservative thresholds initially
Risk: Bench becomes a deployment bottleneck. Mitigation: tiered evaluation where fast lightweight checks run first and expensive tests run asynchronously for canary only
Risk: Overblocking reduces optimization velocity. Mitigation: provide an explicit override flow with documented human review and temporary exception window
Risk: Data privacy for sampled production prompts. Mitigation: strip user identifiers, enforce retention policy, and log approvals for audits
